statements.text: A Section 301 tariff is a U.S. trade remedy duty applied to specific products from China following a trade investigation. For PCB buyers, it matters because it can add a significant duty to China-origin boards or assemblies even when the base HTS duty rate is Free.
China-origin PCBs and some PCBAs can face a 25% Section 301 tariff unless a valid exclusion applies.

Section 301 tariffs add an extra duty to covered China-origin goods on top of the normal HTS duty rate. For many China-origin PCB imports, the normal base duty may be Free, but Section 301 can add 25% unless a valid exclusion applies.
For many China-origin bare PCBs under HTS 8534.00 and certain PCBAs under HTS 8473.30.1180, the additional Section 301 tariff is 25% unless a product-specific exclusion applies.
Unless renewed, the 2 and 4-layer exemption from the 25% Section 301 Tariffs are set to expire at the end of May this year.
